# Tyler Lindow | Engineering Manager | Developer experience, platform, merchant & partner integrations | Ex-Affirm | Ex-founder

Public story for https://tlindow.github.io

The working resume is at /resume. The summary below is the locked public summary.

## Summary
Led up to 9 engineers on Affirm's merchant and partner integrations and developer experience. Cut higher-transaction merchant outage detection from ~1 hour to under 5 minutes, led a merchant domain architecture review that reshaped the merchant org, and took Merchant Portal from ~99.7% to 99.9% availability with zero BFCM 2025 incidents. As founder of Beginner Work, built Tinker, an IDE for founders who want to get more technical. Targeting EM / Senior EM roles in developer experience, developer platforms, and partner integrations.

## Themes
- Building Product as System Architecture: https://tlindow.github.io/blog/building-product-as-system-architecture

## Experience
### Founder and CEO | Beginner Work Inc.
Mar 2026 – Jul 2026
Self-funded and built Tinker, an IDE for founders who want to get more technical (essays capturing the founder's voice, a code editor, and an AI terminal generating diffs from that context); shipped and open-sourced it as offline-first desktop and web apps, reaching 28 early users. Ran 87 conversations with founders, Tinker's early target users, and 5 with VCs across SF, NYC, and LA, then wound the company down rather than fund a GTM that wasn't compounding. Product: https://www.beginner.work Source: https://github.com/beginner-work/tinker

### Software Engineering Manager, Merchant Engineering | Affirm
Mar 2025 – Feb 2026
Led Merchant Advocacy Engineering (9 engineers at peak, deliberately reshaped to 6), owning Merchant Portal, the API-key and transaction-view surface for merchants integrated via ecommerce platforms or direct API. Raised Merchant Portal availability from ~99.7% to 99.9% with zero BFCM 2025 incidents by leading the team in moving its reads off Snowflake onto the merchant data platform's read-replica RPCs. Raised the team's building time from ~10–20% to 50%+; that 6-person team carried the shift to building, the Merchant Portal reliability work, and the Intuit fix. Led a merchant domain architecture review after which Affirm consolidated Merchant Risk and Merchant Advocacy under one EM, moved former developer-support engineers into SRE, and added PM investment in direct merchant customer problems.

### Developer Support Engineering Manager, Partner Engineering | Affirm
Jul 2021 – Mar 2025
Company-scale engineering management for developer support and partner integrations.

### Developer Support Engineer, Partner Engineering | Affirm
Sep 2019 – Jul 2021
Developer-facing merchant integration support on the partner surface.

### Earlier
Galvanize Inc (May 2019 – Aug 2019), The Tech Interactive (May 2017 – Jan 2019), Computer History Museum (Mar 2017 – Nov 2018).
